column1: # Expected differences between the inventory of FreePBX 16 before the migration
# and the one of FreePBX 17 after it (M7, izpbx-inventory --diff --mapping).
# "CATEGORY<TAB>REGEX<TAB>REPLACEMENT": REGEX replaced in the records before;
# "CATEGORY<TAB>REGEX<TAB>" (empty replacement): records left out on both sides;
# "CATEGORY<TAB>additions": records only after are no difference;
# "CATEGORY<TAB>ignore": category not compared; a 4th field "both" applies the
# replacement to the records after too. Any other difference stops the
# migration (maintenance mode with the report).
# chan_sip extensions and trunks converted to PJSIP by the restore (D3)
extensions
trunks
astdb
astdb
# keys FreePBX 17 writes that the 16 may lack (the hints of extensions made by
# bulk SQL, 20.16.22-large); a key of the 16 missing or changed still counts
astdb
# generated by each installation, or runtime states
astdb
astdb
# PJSIP contacts of the registered phones (res_pjsip registrar): they
# register again after the migration, with new keys
astdb
# the default user of a device: FreePBX 17 writes it again from the devices
# table (a value left in the astdb of the 16 by a device login, or out of
# sync with the database, is not kept)
astdb
# WebRTC devices of the webrtc module: their name comes from the name of the
# user at the restore, the 16 may still have the name of a previous user
extensions
# phonebook has no FreePBX 17 release: left out on purpose (D28)
modules
# the new installation adds its default modules (FREEPBX_MODULES_EXTRA) that an
# older 20.16 did not have (20.16.0: infoservices, music); a module of the 16
# missing or with another state is still a difference
modules
# the reserved empty file of the music on hold, written by the music module
moh
# Advanced Settings: AMI credentials, versions and the settings izPBX sets differ
advanced_settings
# fop2.cfg: the AMI keys are written at every start (migration_fop2 keeps the rest)
files
# only in the inventory of a running Asterisk (--live)
pjsip_endpoints
